raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that “My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy” was not released under Roc-A-Fella and, based on that false premise, pivoted to “Graduation.” This contradicted prior evidence (e.g., the “Power” single credited to Roc-A-Fella and the Wikipedia page linking “Power” to MBDTF). The misinterpretation of label information led to an unwarranted final conclusion despite gathered sources supporting MBDTF as the correct Roc-A-Fella album featuring Dwele.
